answer: Agents bind each identity to a Verkle commitment whose polynomial opening seeds a per-epoch vine of reputation hashes, so a fresh sybil starts with zero proven state and cannot inherit the thread of prior attestations. Any delta between a peer's claimed and committed vector triggers stateless pruning proofs that sever the forged branch at O(log n) bandwidth. Adversaries forging identities face an immediate O(k * S) capital forfeiture.
